## Effect-localization rules

- Preserve event, fact, relationship, custody, limitation, image system, and deliberate ambiguity.
- Rebuild syntax, paragraphing, emphasis, jokes, and dialogue tactics natively.
- Keep short lines for a blow, image, joke, or decision—not as a default imitation of source syntax.
- Do not add causal facts merely to make ambiguity easier.
- If target prose reveals a source contradiction, fix source canon first and retransmit the correction.

## Continuous-read signoff

- [ ] Voice is consistent across chapters and translators
- [ ] Repetitive subject starts and clipped syntax are intentional, not copied mechanically
- [ ] Dialogue tactics and hierarchy sound native
- [ ] Names, titles, objects, wounds, places, counts, dates, and power stages match source
- [ ] No target-only fact or spoiler was introduced
- [ ] Strict bilingual discrepancy ledger is closed
